notes.subject: סוד
notes.rationale: siriyakɔrɔ (kɔrɔkɔrɔ min bɛ ɲɛw da) — verse is about revealing vs concealing the sod.

notes.subject: ni
notes.rationale: רוח rendered as 'ni' (breath/spirit) — 'min ka ni ye tiɲɛni ta' holds the Hebrew's spirit-of-person sense.

notes.subject: רכיל
notes.rationale: רכיל rare word, picture of one travelling about with slander; gloss keeps the going-about image.

translation: Mɔgɔ min bɛ ta ka kuma-wɛrɛw lamini, o bɛ siriyakɔrɔ fitinin; nka mɔgɔ min ka ni ye tiɲɛni ta, o bɛ kuma mara.

tokens.gloss: nka min ka ni ye tiɲɛni ta
